SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 36
Date Sept. 13, 1940.

Subject Ordure Coolies in the French Concession - strike called off.

Made by D.I. Fan Lien Pih Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

Sent, 14/9.

The 600 ordure coolies in the French
Concession, who declared a strike on September 9,
in order to enforce demands for better treatment
including an increase in wages, resumed work at
2 a.m. September 13.

Between 6 p.m. and 7.30 p.m. on September 12,
a mediation meeting took place in the office of the
Shanghai Municipality General Labour Union, at Lane 247,
5 (Wong Ka Sz Dong), Chung Hwa Road, Nantao. Woo
Siao Lung (胡兆麟), Chairman of the above labour
union and Kiang Siao Foong (江曉風), representative
from the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai
City Government, were present. During the meeting
the following terms were agreed upon by both the
management and the ordure coolies :-

1. That a report be made by the management
requesting the French Police Authority to
amend the regulations governing the impositions
of fines on ordure coolies for breach of
police regulations; the hours of operating
the ordure carts and the route by which the
ordure carts will pass.

2. That a wage increase of $4.50 per mensem
be granted to each of the coolies.

3. That a waterproof hat made of bamboo, be
issued by the management to each of the coolies.

4. That in case of any damage sustained by an
ordure cart, the coolie concerned will
compensate the owner in accordance with the
regulations enforced prior to the Sino-
Japanese hostilities in 1937.

Fan Lien-pih
D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)

（印：FIXED BY REGISTRY DATE 17/9 '40）
（批：13/9）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 36
日期 1940年9月13日。

主题 法租界粪夫——罢工取消。

呈报人：警探范连璧（Fan Lien Pih） 转呈人：副督察长洛根（Logan）

发送，9月14日。

法租界的600名粪夫于9月9日宣布罢工，以强制要求改善待遇，包括增加工资，他们已于9月13日凌晨2时复工。

9月12日下午6时至7时30分之间，在南市中华路5号（王家祠堂）247弄的上海市总工会办公室举行了一次调解会议。上述工会主席胡兆麟（Woo Siao Lung）和上海市政府社会局代表江晓风（Kiang Siao Foong）出席了会议。会议期间，资方与粪夫双方商定了以下条款：-

1. 由资方提交报告，请求法国警察当局修订关于对违反警察规章的粪夫处以罚款的规定；修订粪车作业时间以及粪车通行路线。

2. 每位苦力每月加薪4.50元。

3. 由资方向每位苦力发放一顶竹制防水帽。

4. 若粪车遭受任何损坏，相关苦力将依照1937年中日敌对行动发生之前实施的规章向车主赔偿。

范连璧
警探
特务科副主任

（印章：登记处固定日期 1940年9月17日）
（批注：9月13日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 3627
Date. Sept. 10, 1940.
Subject Strike of ordure coolies in the French Concession.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

Approximately 600 ordure coolies who are
employed by the ordure contractor, Chang Zuan Kee
(張泉記), No.2 Rue Bluntechli, operating in the
French Concession, declared a strike in the early
morning of September 9, in order to enforce the
following six demands :-
1. That the fines as laid down in the
French Police Regulations be abolished.
2. That the time limit for operating ordure
carts in the street be extended from
8.30 a.m. to 10.30 a.m. daily.
3. That an increase of $5.00 be granted to
each of the coolies.
4. That a raincoat be issued to each of
the coolies.
5. That a hospital be established for
the benefit of the ordure coolies.
6. That a subsidy be given to the ordure
coolies' union.
(The ordure coolies in the French Concession
have a labour union known as the 2nd District
Ordure Coolies' Union, at Lane 247, No.5
Chung Hwa Road, Nantao. It is supported
by the Shanghai Municipality General Labour
Union.)
The ordure coolies' contractor refused to accede
to the above demands.
It is interesting to note that the strike
has been engineered by the Shanghai Municipality
General Labour Union (上海特別市總工會).

Commr of Police.
Sir,
R.E. Yorke.

（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 17 SEPT. 1940）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 3627
日期 1940年9月10日。
主题 法租界粪夫罢工。
呈报人：警探潘连璧（Pan Lien Pih） 转呈人：副督察长洛根（Logan）

受雇于法租界内运营的粪业承包商张泉记（Chang Zuan Kee）（地址：Bluntechli路2号）的大约600名粪夫，于9月9日凌晨宣布罢工，以强制推行以下六项要求：-
1. 废除法国警察规章中规定的罚款。
2. 将街道上粪车作业的时间限制从每天上午8:30延长至上午10:30。
3. 每位苦力加薪5.00元。
4. 向每位苦力发放一件雨衣。
5. 为造福粪夫而建立一所医院。
6. 向粪夫工会提供补贴。
（法租界的粪夫拥有一个名为“第二区粪夫工会”的工会，地址位于南市中华路5号247弄。该工会得到上海市总工会的支持。）
粪夫承包商拒绝接受上述要求。
值得注意的是，此次罢工是由上海市总工会（上海特別市總工會）策划的。

警务处处长。
先生，
R.E. 约克（Yorke）。

（印章：上海警务处处长办公室 1940年9月17日）
